verification.precondition: A valid post-bootstrap candidate session has identity v4, a complete initialization boundary, neutral runtime projections, and a valid final root seal.
verification.stimulus: Apply one adversarial mutation for every R12 excluded-field class, recompute the public root seal where applicable, and run keyed, semantic, replay, projection, and seal proofs.
verification.expectedSemanticState: Every excluded projection remains either structurally frozen or exactly rederived, and no public reseal can make a changed value acceptable.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports the literal assertion: R12 rejects every excluded-field matrix tamper after public root resealing
verification.forbiddenMutation: No excluded runtime field, sibling Question content, unauthenticated view, dependency suffix, stale projection, or post-proof mutation may survive cold validation.

behavior: R12 rejects every excluded-field matrix tamper after public root resealing
